messages:
Nora | Sales: Handoff for Lighthouse Health trial (18 days left). Region: eu-west-1. They handle PHI, requested BA, want Private deploy + BYOK. POC target: integration + perf. Sending to @Chen to run CS. Demo link: https://rwd.inc/demos/lighthouse

Chen | CS: Thanks @Nora — taking point. Whos the main contact and whats expected traffic? Any retention/compliance specifics?

Nora | Sales: Org: LH-77. Contact: jules@lighthouse.io (CTO). Baseline ~8k tokens/day, peaks to ~45k during tests. They want 1yr audit log retention, SAML+SCIM, and KMS rotation policy. Procurement asked for Dedicated + Private quote by next Friday.

handoff-bot: Ticket CH-7717 created: "Lighthouse onboarding - SSO/Private/BYOK". Priority: P1. Assignees: Omar, Elena. https://rwd.inc/tickets/CH-7717

Omar | Support: I can run SAML test as soon as we have IdP metadata and a test account. If SAML delays us we can issue temporary API keys for dev. Also need SCIM creds.

Elena | Eng: For private deployment we need CIDR ranges, networking contact, and model choice + expected QPS. Rough effort: 3 dev-days + 1 infra day. BYOK requires their key ARN.

Chen | CS: Model: open-orion-13b, expected peak QPS ~50, avg seq len ~200. Success metric: 90% requests <180ms p50. Tagging as renewal-risk until quote confirmed. Scheduling kickoff Thu 11am CET.

Nora | Sales: Sent IdP metadata to Omar. LOI mentions BA — looping legal. I'll chase procurement for quote details.

legal-bot: Legal review requested for CH-7717: BA present in LOI. Assigned to legal-team.

Elena | Eng: Note: private VPC will require subnet peering and NAT. Please add their network owner and CIDR to CH-7717.

Chen | CS: Next steps: 1) SAML + SCIM test (Omar) 2) Customer provides CIDR + network contact (Customer) 3) Connector dev ETA (Elena) 4) Quote for Dedicated/Private (Nora) 5) Kickoff Thu 11am CET. I'll track weekly checkpoints and collect post-POC feedback.

Omar | Support: Acknowledged. I'll post SAML logs in the ticket after tests.

Elena | Eng: I'll post a connector plan and ETA by EOD tomorrow. Please attach model artifact and tokenization profile to CH-7717.

Chen | CS: Thanks all  leaving thread open for updates. Will update after kickoff and first SAML run.
